title: Agentic SWE agent role
description: One file per role under config/roles/. The pre-tool policy hook enforces tools and privileged_actions; budget, review and escalation are recorded for the dispatcher and review gates.

id.description: Role id; must match the file name without .json.

agents.description: Prompt files that act in this role. Each file's frontmatter name must be listed in agent_types.

agent_types.description: Host agent names for this role, matched against the hook's agent_type with any '<plugin>:' prefix removed. Empty for the main session (hypervisor).

tools.description: Allowed tools: class names (read, search, edit, shell, web, spawn, mcp, plan) or tool-name globs. Any other tool is denied for this role.

privileged_actions.description: Privileged actions this role may take, each only while an authorization record for it exists. Unlisted actions are always denied.

budget.description: Per-phase limits for the dispatcher (AE-014). Not enforced by the hook.

required.description: Whether this role's output needs independent review before it is accepted.

by.description: Role ids that may review it.

review.description: Review requirement for the review gate (AE-016). Not enforced by the hook.
